races.name: Coral 'Bet5 Get30 New Customer Offer' 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
STRIDE ON is a very interesting chasing debutant and could be worth chancing over form pick Jeriko du Reponet, who is proving expensive to follow over fences.

  1. STRIDE ON (IRE)
  2. JERIKO DU REPONET (FR)
  3. WELONLYHAVEDONE (IRE)

races.name: Coral 'Pipped-At-The-Post And Win' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ATTIN and Jet of Stars both looked good when winning bumpers in the spring. Slight preference is for the former, as Jet of Stars must prove his well-being after suffering a health problem on his hurdles bow. Penalised winner Moon Reign is the only other realistic contender.

  1. ATTIN (FR)
  2. JET OF STARS (IRE)
  3. MOON REIGN

races.name: Coral 'Daily Rewards Shaker' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
JACK DEMPSEY caught the eye from a long way back when second at Carlisle 3 weeks ago and can go one better. Beat The Retreat also ran well on his comeback so is next best ahead of Athair Mor, who's often thereabouts.

  1. JACK DEMPSEY
  2. BEAT THE RETREAT (IRE)
  3. ATHAIR MOR (IRE)

races.name: 'Play Coral Racing-Super-Series For Free' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BOSTON JURY looks as if he has revived for his new yard so he could be the answer with the return to this longer trip sure to suit. This does look competitive, though, with handicap debutant Allfor and course specialist The Jeweller's Pet completing the shortlist.

  1. BOSTON JURY (IRE)
  2. ALLFOR (IRE)
  3. THE JEWELLER'S PET (IRE)

races.name: Coral 'We're Here For It' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
None of these can be ruled out with slight preference for BRIDGE COURT, who is expected to leave his reappearance run well behind. No Regrets is back on a workable mark so is next best.

  1. BRIDGE COURT (IRE)
  2. NO REGRETS (IRE)
  3. GREEN ANGEL (IRE)

races.name: 'Join Coral-Racing-Club For Free' NH Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur Jockeys) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DOUBLE ANNIE was a wide-margin winner on her second outing in Irish points and makes plenty of appeal now setting out under Rules for an in-form yard in an ordinary-looking race. Eillis is entitled to build on her debut promise back in May and is preferred to Pony Express for forecast purposes, with the latter having shown signs of temperament.

  1. DOUBLE ANNIE (IRE)
  2. EILLIS (IRE)
  3. PONY EXPRESS

races.name: Dudley Peverill Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SERAPHIC is now going the right way for his current yard and remains well treated on his form in France, so he's fancied to complete the hat-trick. Mariole is entitled to come on for his recent comeback run at Worcester and is second choice.

  1. SERAPHIC (IRE)
  2. MARIOLE (FR)
  3. MISTER DES PLACES (FR)

races.name: FCN Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LARGY FORCE was thriving over fences when last seen and, back over hurdles after a breathing operation, looks worth siding with under favourable conditions. Stablemate Kefir d’Oudairies is the main threat if belatedly building on last season’s Market Rasen second, while Dylans Moon is also dangerous if reproducing his debut form.

  1. LARGY FORCE (IRE)
  2. KEFIR D'OUDAIRIES (FR)
  3. DYLANS MOON

races.name: Arnold Thomson Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A trappy contest in which ADONEDEAL is chanced on chase debut. Having looked promising over hurdles before his form tailed off last season, this winning pointer should take to fences and may be the type to catch first time up. Fresh Perspective is feared most if his jumping holds up, while Crystal Days and Soldier’s Leap are also respected in a race where cases can be made for all 4 runners.

  1. ADONEDEAL (IRE)
  2. FRESH PERSPECTIVE
  3. CRYSTAL DAYS

races.name: Newton LDP Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BROADWAY HONEY has proved a revelation since tackling the larger obstacles and this looks an excellent opportunity for Nigel & Willy Twiston-Davies' mare to extend her winning sequence to 4. Ignore The Door promises to be suited by a return to this longer trip so he can edge out Yes Day for the forecast spot.

  1. BROADWAY HONEY (IRE)
  2. IGNORE THE DOOR (IRE)
  3. YES DAY (IRE)

races.name: BNG Made Easy With Reverte Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for a few of these, but the vote goes to PADDY DE POLE, who notched his fifth success over hurdles at Sedgefield a couple of months ago and Paul Nicholls' 8-y-o returns only 2 lb higher. He can enhance his fine record under Freddie Keighley at the expense of Jackstell, whose yard couldn't be in much better form. Oakley looks best of the rest.

  1. PADDY DE POLE (IRE)
  2. JACKSTELL (FR)
  3. OAKLEY (GER)

races.name: Pegasus Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
TROPICAL TALENT hasn't won for ages but recent performances in this sphere suggest that could be about to change. Sporting first-time blinkers, he gets the vote over Alba Crus, who was in the process of running well on his chasing debut back in the spring and returns having had a breathing operation. Top-weight Mary rounds off the shortlist.

  1. TROPICAL TALENT
  2. ALBA CRUS (IRE)
  3. MARY (IRE)

races.name: Farol Fillies' 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KATIES TURN hails from a stable with a good bumper record and is selected to make a winning start. Sunshine Sheila is partnered by a good-value claimer and is also respected on her debut, while Nervousdisposition's pedigree suggests that an emphasis on speed will suit her better than most.

  1. KATIES TURN
  2. SUNSHINE SHEILA (FR)
  3. NERVOUSDISPOSITION

races.name: Overton Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CHUGGY is in the perfect hands to kick on as a second-season chaser and it's not hard to envisage him returning with a bang and making all here. Wandering Ego is sure to step up on his chasing debut effort, while Laguna Beach commands respect tackling the larger obstacles for the first time.

  1. CHUGGY
  2. WANDERING EGO (IRE)
  3. LAGUNA BEACH (FR)

races.name: Yorton Mares' Novices' Chase (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This has a very open look to it but MIGHTY FLEUR arrives here on a roll and with race fitness and chasing experience on her side, that may count for plenty as she tackles a step up in grade. Jubilee Alpha was just about the best of these over hurdles so it will be interesting to see what Faye Bramley can do with her, while Sunset Marquesa is another nice prospect over the larger obstacles.

  1. MIGHTY FLEUR
  2. JUBILEE ALPHA (IRE)
  3. SUNSET MARQUESA (IRE)

races.name: Weatherbys & Birdie Calendars Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FIRST CONFESSION found 3¾m too much of a test at Cheltenham when last seen in March but back over a more suitable trip in a lesser handicap, he could get on the up returning for his in-form stable. Broomfields Cave and Arizona Cardinal also reappear, the latter from a huge lay-off but both are interesting.

  1. FIRST CONFESSION (IRE)
  2. BROOMFIELDS CAVE (IRE)
  3. ARIZONA CARDINAL

races.name: Bangor-On-Dee Memberships Now On Sale EBF Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A field consisting of 7 newcomers, with preference going to ROCKSON PIEL, a Harry Derham-trained half-brother to the useful hurdler Steel Ally. Agafay is highly respected for the Greatrex yard, whilst Fika also makes appeal on paper.

  1. ROCKSON PIEL (FR)
  2. AGAFAY (FR)
  3. FIKA

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Assuming he takes to hurdling at the first attempt, useful Flat recruit ALCARATH is expected to outclass these. Sears Crossing and Frost Moon may be of more interest further down the line but can still make their presence felt at this level.

  1. ALCARATH (IRE)
  2. SEARS CROSSING (IRE)
  3. FROST MOON (IRE)

races.name: Wrexham Lager Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SOLID PERFORMER has shown more than enough to think a race of this nature is within his grasp and he holds excellent claims on seasonal bow. Mr Rafiki comfortably rates the chief danger to Donald McCain's 8-y-o.

  1. SOLID PERFORMER (IRE)
  2. MR RAFIKI (IRE)
  3. CAPTAIN CONNOR (FR)

races.name: Festive Meeting Saturday 28th November Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
There should be plenty more to come from BROOKSIDE LA this season and in receipt of weight all round, he looks the way to go after an impressive performance at Worcester. Charisma Cat and The Cistercian are feared most.

  1. BROOKSIDE LA (IRE)
  2. CHARISMA CAT
  3. THE CISTERCIAN (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict:
LETHIMFLY has been hit quite hard for his recent impressive Wolverhampton win but remains well treated on his old form and can follow up over recent C&D winner Jordan Breeze. One Cool Bear can make the placings for the third start in a row.

  1. LETHIMFLY (IRE)
  2. JORDAN BREEZE (IRE)
  3. ONE COOL BEAR (IRE)

races.name: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
INVINCIBLE IRISH improved when runner-up at Down Royal last time and can go one place better over a trip that promises to suit. Stablemate Dragon Scales is also respected on her debut in nursery company, with Professor Finnegan completing the shortlist.

  1. INVINCIBLE IRISH (IRE)
  2. DRAGON SCALES (IRE)
  3. PROFESSOR FINNEGAN (IRE)

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Claiming Race
races.verdict:
SHOOT TO KILL is better here than anywhere else and looks the most solid option on these terms. Justenzia did well to win over further here on Friday and is another to consider, while Leonie is capable of going very close if seeing out the longer trip for her new yard.

  1. SHOOT TO KILL (IRE)
  2. JUSTENZIA (IRE)
  3. LEONIE

races.name: Bet On The Best Night Out At Dundalk Stadium Maiden
races.verdict:
LOOKINGFORARAINBOW isn't especially progressive but looks a pretty solid option here on the back of her recent C&D second. Resurgence has to shrug off a below-par effort but the overall balance of his form would give him a major shout, with Joseph O'Brien's newcomer Queen Creek also meriting respect.

  1. LOOKINGFORARAINBOW (USA)
  2. RESURGENCE (IRE)
  3. QUEEN CREEK (IRE)

races.name: View Restaurant At Dundalk Stadium Median Auction Maiden
races.verdict:
Plenty of dead wood in this maiden and MARCESCENCE is selected to make it third time lucky having shaped promisingly when placed in a couple of Navan maidens. This step up to 7f looks a good move and she can get the better of Sonic Sabiha, who was suspended under the non-triers rule at Listowel in September but has run well here on both subsequent outings. Direct Action and Jade Fox can fight out minor honours.

  1. MARCESCENCE (IRE)
  2. SONIC SABIHA (IRE)
  3. DIRECT ACTION

races.name: Celebrate Your Special Occasion At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict:
GO OUT opened his account at Dundalk 12 days ago and, with first-time blinkers now applied, he is taken to follow up. The lightly-raced Teffian Warrior is the main threat if building on his handicap debut, while reliable sort Boston Max is also likely to be involved.

  1. GO OUT (FR)
  2. TEFFIAN WARRIOR (IRE)
  3. BOSTON MAX (IRE)

races.name: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Handicap
races.verdict:
EASTERN PEACE is a C&D winner from last winter and backed up her previous effort when fourth here 26 days ago, so she is fancied to resume winning ways with Billy Lee taking the reins, while Speckled Meadow rates the main danger from a lower all-weather mark and Sherekiya is respected with this trip expected to suit.

  1. EASTERN PEACE (IRE)
  2. SPECKLED MEADOW (IRE)
  3. SHEREKIYA (IRE)
